Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company LTD. (NYSE:TSM)’s Stock Is Buy After Less Market Selling Posted by Dolores Ford 02 pm
The stock of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company LTD. (NYSE:TSM) registered a decrease of 0.29% in short interest. TSM’s total short interest was 17.38M shares in January as published by FINRA. Its down 0.29% from 17.43 million shares, reported previously. With 9.97M shares average volume, it will take short sellers 2 days to cover their TSM’s short positions. The short interest to Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company LTD.’s float is 0.36%.
The stock increased 1.52% or $0.55 during the last trading session, reaching $36.84. About 12.91M shares traded or 30.72% up from the average. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has declined 6.61% since January 19, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 6.61% the S&P500.
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the computer-aided design, manufacture, packaging, testing, sale, and marketing of integrated circuits, color filters, and other semiconductor devices primarily in Taiwan. The company has market cap of $186.36 billion. It makes masks and electronic parts; sells solar related products; wholesales and retails electronic materials; and researches, develops, and tests RFID systems. It has a 16.52 P/E ratio. The firm is also involved in customer service and technical supporting, marketing and engineering supporting, and investment activities.
